subject: MAP draft: CrestPay pilot — security gates, DPA & retention
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@crestpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft: CrestPay pilot — security gates, DPA & retention

Alice — attaching a lightweight MAP for the pilot so we can lock the close timeline and the security gating items. Key items called out below; full attachments include the SOC 2 summary and a snapshot of our SIG/CAIQ. Attachments: redwood-soc2-2027-summary.pdf, redwood-sig-caiq-snapshot.xlsx, redwood-dpa-draft-jan2028.docx

High level (proposed):
- Pilot kickoff: Feb 6 (technical PoC) — customer test data only, isolated project workspace
- Acceptance gates (pre-production):
  1) SOC 2: provide attestation summary + runbook for incident response (target: SOC 2 Type II report + SOC 2 runbook delivered within 10 business days of contract signature)
  2) SIG/CAIQ: provide completed snapshot and clarifications on data flows (we can supply a pre-filled sheet)
  3) DPA: agree on retention windows and subprocessor list; initial redline attached
- Data retention proposal: 30 days for KV cache by default, 365 days for audit logs unless CrestPay requires shorter windows; residency is US only for this engagement
- Contingency: if evidence for SOC 2 is delayed beyond 3 weeks, we propose staged access (test tokens, no production keys) to unblock engineering

Ask: can you confirm the acceptance gates above and whether a Feb 24 commercial close target is realistic? If CrestPay needs additional evidence items, list them and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@crestpay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@crestpay.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: CrestPay pilot — security gates, DPA & retention

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. A few clarifications from Compliance: 

- SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report or an SOC 2 bridge letter if the full report is older than 12 months. Can you confirm the report date?
- SIG/CAIQ: the snapshot looks good but Compliance will request a short narrative on data flows for any PII handling — specifically where embeddings and tokenized content are stored and for how long.
- DPA: retention windows are the primary concern. CrestPay data classification requires that customer PII be purged from transient caches within 7 days unless an exemption is granted. Is there an optional shorter retention profile we can choose?

If we can get the SOC evidence and a short DPA redline by Jan 20, we can keep Feb 24 as a go/no-go for commercial signoff. If not, we’ll need to push the decision meeting by two weeks. 

Alice Nguyen
VP, Platform Security — CrestPay
alice.nguyen@crestpay.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: CrestPay pilot — security gates, DPA & retention

On Wed, Jan 11, 2028 at 11:07 AM Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@crestpay.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. A few clarifications from Compliance: 
> 
> - SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report or an SOC 2 bridge letter if the full report is older than 12 months. Can you confirm the report date?
> - SIG/CAIQ: the snapshot looks good but Compliance will request a short narrative on data flows for any PII handling — specifically where embeddings and tokenized content are stored and for how long.
> - DPA: retention windows are the primary concern. CrestPay data classification requires that customer PII be purged from transient caches within 7 days unless an exemption is granted. Is there an optional shorter retention profile we can choose?

Folks — looping in Laura from Legal on the DPA retention carveouts. Quick notes and next steps: 

- SOC 2: our latest Type II report is 2027-09-30. I’ve attached a 2-page summary (redwood-soc2-2027-summary.pdf) and we can provide a bridge letter if they insist on <12 months.
- SIG/CAIQ: Ben will produce a one-paragraph data flow narrative for PII in the pilot by EOD Friday (see attachment redwood-sig-caiq-snapshot.xlsx).
- DPA & retention: Laura, per CrestPay’s 7-day cache ask — we can support a short-term cache profile (7 days) for PII keys; default audit logs retention stays at 365 days. Laura, can we offer the 7-day cache as a configurable plan in the DPA and include a limited exemption process?

Proposed internal owners & timing:
- SOC evidence: Legal/Compliance team to provide targeted bridge letter if requested — owner: Marissa — due Jan 18
- Data flow narrative: owner Ben Carter — due Jan 13 EOD
- DPA redline with configurable retention: owner Laura Bennett — draft by Jan 17

I’ll draft a reply to Alice summarizing we can do 7-day cache for PII and outline the staged access fallback if SOC evidence runs late.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Manager, Customer Security
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@crestpay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: CrestPay pilot — security gates, DPA & retention

Alice — quick update and commitments: 

- SOC 2: confirmed report date 2027-09-30. We can provide a bridge letter if required. Attached: redwood-soc2-2027-summary.pdf.
- SIG/CAIQ & data flow narrative: attached workbook (redwood-sig-caiq-snapshot.xlsx) plus short narrative: "Embeddings are derived in-memory during inference and not persisted to long-term storage. Tokenized transient caches persist up to configurable retention; for CrestPay pilot we will enable the 7-day PII cache profile. Audit logs (non-PII) will remain 365 days in US-only residency."
- DPA: Laura attached a redline (redwood-dpa-draft-jan2028.docx) with a configurable retention clause and an exemption approval flow for longer retention (legal approval only).

Next steps to keep Feb 24 commercial close: 
1) CrestPay confirms acceptance of the 7-day PII cache profile (or proposes a written exception) by Jan 22.
2) CrestPay legal to review DPA redline in DocuSign by Jan 25 (DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEFG123456).
3) Internal: Marissa to produce bridge letter if requested by Jan 18 (in progress).

If we hit those milestones we will proceed with staged provisioning: test tokens on Feb 6; production keys issued after signed DPA and completion of SOC evidence check.

Thanks and happy to jump on a 30-min call if you want to walk the MAP.

Ben Carter
Principal Security Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0222

Attachments: redwood-soc2-2027-summary.pdf; redwood-sig-caiq-snapshot.xlsx; redwood-dpa-draft-jan2028.docx
